    88	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    89	// BeadStatus
    90	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    91	
    92	/// Lifecycle status of a bead in the store.
    93	#[non_exhaustive]
    94	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    95	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    96	pub enum BeadStatus {
    97	    Open,
    98	    InProgress,
    99	    /// `bf` (bead-forge) has been observed emitting `"completed"` for done
   100	    /// beads on some workspaces (bf's own `Status` enum has no `Completed`
   101	    /// variant — it falls through to an untagged `Custom(String)`, so this
   102	    /// slips through bf-side validation). Accept it as an alias so a single
   103	    /// such bead doesn't fail `bf list --json` deserialization for every
   104	    /// other bead in the same call — see needle-weave-completed-status.
   105	    #[serde(alias = "completed")]
   106	    Done,
   107	    /// `br show --json` emits `"closed"` for done beads. Treat as equivalent
   108	    /// to `Done` so deserialization succeeds.
   109	    Closed,
   110	    Blocked,
   111	    /// `bf` (bead-forge) emits `"deferred"` for beads deliberately postponed
   112	    /// rather than blocked by a dependency. Distinct from `Blocked`: a
   113	    /// deferred bead has no unmet dependency, it was just set aside — see
   114	    /// GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#10. Without this variant, `bf list --json`
   115	    /// fails deserialization for every such bead, and it silently disappears
   116	    /// from strand/supervise visibility with no surfaced error.
   117	    Deferred,
   118	}
   119	
   120	impl BeadStatus {
   121	    /// Returns true if the bead is finished (either `Done` or `Closed`).
   122	    pub fn is_done(&self) -> bool {
   123	        matches!(self, BeadStatus::Done | BeadStatus::Closed)
   124	    }
   125	}
   126	
   127	impl fmt::Display for BeadStatus {
   128	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
   129	        match self {
   130	            BeadStatus::Open => write!(f, "open"),
   131	            BeadStatus::InProgress => write!(f, "in_progress"),
   132	            BeadStatus::Done | BeadStatus::Closed => write!(f, "done"),
   133	            BeadStatus::Blocked => write!(f, "blocked"),
   134	            BeadStatus::Deferred => write!(f, "deferred"),
   135	        }
   136	    }
   137	}

   139	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   140	// WorkerState
   141	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   142	
   143	/// Worker finite-state-machine states.
   144	///
   145	/// Every state has defined entry conditions, actions, and exit transitions.
   146	/// There are no implicit states or fallthrough paths.
   147	#[non_exhaustive]
   148	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   149	#[serde(rename_all = "SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE")]
   150	pub enum WorkerState {
   151	    Booting,
   152	    Selecting,
   153	    Claiming,
   154	    Retrying,
   155	    Building,
   156	    Dispatching,
   157	    Executing,
   158	    Handling,
   159	    Logging,
   160	    /// All strands returned empty — worker has nothing to do.
   161	    Exhausted,
   162	    /// Received graceful shutdown signal.
   163	    Stopped,
   164	    /// Unrecoverable error.
   165	    Errored,
   166	}
   167	
   168	impl fmt::Display for WorkerState {
   169	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
   170	        let s = match self {
   171	            WorkerState::Booting => "BOOTING",
   172	            WorkerState::Selecting => "SELECTING",
   173	            WorkerState::Claiming => "CLAIMING",
   174	            WorkerState::Retrying => "RETRYING",
   175	            WorkerState::Building => "BUILDING",
   176	            WorkerState::Dispatching => "DISPATCHING",
   177	            WorkerState::Executing => "EXECUTING",
   178	            WorkerState::Handling => "HANDLING",
   179	            WorkerState::Logging => "LOGGING",
   180	            WorkerState::Exhausted => "EXHAUSTED",
   181	            WorkerState::Stopped => "STOPPED",
   182	            WorkerState::Errored => "ERRORED",
   183	        };
   184	        f.write_str(s)
   185	    }
   186	}

   188	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   189	// Outcome
   190	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   191	
   192	/// The classified outcome of an agent process.
   193	///
   194	/// Every exit code maps to exactly one variant via `Outcome::classify()`.
   195	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
   196	pub enum Outcome {
   197	    /// Exit 0 — agent completed work successfully.
   198	    Success,
   199	    /// Non-zero exit indicating a failure (includes app errors 1-99 and unknown codes).
   200	    Failure,
   201	    /// Exit 100 or 124 — timeout wrapper expired.
   202	    Timeout,
   203	    /// Exit 126 or 127 — agent binary not found or not executable.
   204	    AgentNotFound,
   205	    /// Exit 130 (SIGINT) or 143 (SIGTERM) — agent was interrupted.
   206	    Interrupted,
   207	    /// Negative exit code — process crashed or was killed by a signal.
   208	    Crash(i32),
   209	}

   218	    /// - `was_interrupted=true` → `Interrupted` (checked first)
   219	    /// - exit 0 → `Success`
   220	    /// - exit 1 → `Failure`

   285	            self.telemetry.clone(),
   286	        );
   287	
   288	        let peer_result = peer_monitor.check_peers().await?;
   289	        summary.beads_released += peer_result.beads_released;
   290	
   291	        Ok(())
   292	    }
   293	
   294	    // ── Step 1.5: Orphaned in-progress bead recovery ────────────────────────
   295	
   296	    /// Scan all in-progress beads and release any whose assignee does not
   297	    /// correspond to a live worker. This catches beads orphaned by workers
   298	    /// that died without leaving a heartbeat file (or whose heartbeat was
   299	    /// already cleaned up).
   300	    async fn cleanup_orphaned_in_progress(
   301	        &self,
   302	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   303	        summary: &mut MendSummary,
   304	    ) -> Result<()> {
   305	        let released = super::mend::cleanup_orphaned_in_progress(
   306	            store,
   307	            &self.registry,
   308	            &self.telemetry,
   309	            &self.qualified_id,
   310	        )
   311	        .await?;
   312	        summary.beads_released += released;
   313	        Ok(())
   314	    }
   315	
   316	    // ── Step 1.6: Stale assignee cleanup on open beads ─────────────────────────
   317	
   318	    /// Scan all open beads and clear assignees whose workers have no live heartbeat.
   319	    ///
   320	    /// This heals beads that became permanently unclaimable after a reopen
   321	    /// (bead-forge's reopen does not clear assignee). An open bead with a stale
   322	    /// assignee is invisible to all workers because ready() filters out assigned
   323	    /// beads. Clearing the assignee makes it claimable again.
   324	    async fn cleanup_stale_assignees_on_open_beads(
   325	        &self,
   326	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   327	        summary: &mut MendSummary,
   328	    ) -> Result<()> {
   329	        let all_beads = store.list_all().await?;
   330	        let workers = self.registry.list()?;
   331	
   332	        // Build a set of fully-qualified worker IDs for registered, alive workers.
   333	        let live_worker_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = workers
   334	            .iter()
   335	            .filter(|w| HealthMonitor::check_pid_alive(w.pid))
   336	            .map(|w| w.id.clone())
   337	            .collect();
   338	
   339	        for bead in &all_beads {
   340	            // Only check open beads with an assignee.
   341	            if bead.status != BeadStatus::Open {
   342	                continue;
   343	            }
   344	
   345	            let assignee = match &bead.assignee {
   346	                Some(a) if !a.is_empty() => a,
   347	                _ => continue,
   348	            };
   349	
   350	            // Skip if the assignee matches our own qualified identity (we're running).
   351	            if assignee == &self.qualified_id {
   352	                continue;
   353	            }
   354	
   355	            // Skip if the assignee matches a registered, alive worker.
   356	            // Workers register with fully-qualified IDs ({adapter}-{worker_id}),
   357	            // so this comparison prevents collisions when workers from different
   358	            // adapter pools share a NATO name.
   359	            if live_worker_ids.contains(assignee.as_str()) {
   360	                continue;
   361	            }
   362	
   363	            // Stale assignee: clear it so the bead becomes claimable again.
   364	            tracing::info!(
   365	                bead_id = %bead.id,
   366	                assignee = %assignee,
   367	                workspace = %bead.workspace.display(),
   368	                "clearing stale assignee from open bead (assignee has no live worker)"
   369	            );
   370	
   371	            match store.clear_assignee(&bead.id).await {
   372	                Ok(()) => {
   373	                    let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendStaleAssigneeCleared {
   374	                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   375	                        assignee: assignee.clone(),
   376	                    });
   377	                    summary.assignees_cleared += 1;
   378	                }
   379	                Err(e) => {
   380	                    tracing::warn!(
   381	                        bead_id = %bead.id,
   382	                        assignee = %assignee,
   383	                        error = %e,
   384	                        "failed to clear stale assignee from open bead"
   385	                    );
   386	                    let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendAssigneeClearFailed {
   387	                        bead_id: bead.id.to_string(),
   388	                        assignee: assignee.clone(),
   389	                        error: e.to_string(),
   390	                    });
   391	                }
   392	            }
   393	        }
   394	
   395	        Ok(())
   700	            Ok(r) => r,
   701	            Err(e) => {
   702	                tracing::warn!(error = %e, "failed to parse registry file");
   703	                return Ok(());
   704	            }
   705	        };
   706	
   707	        for entry in &raw_reg.workers {
   708	            // Skip our own entry.
   709	            if entry.id == self.qualified_id {
   710	                continue;
   711	            }
   712	
   713	            // Check if the PID is dead.
   714	            if crate::registry::is_pid_alive(entry.pid) {
   715	                continue;
   716	            }
   717	
   718	            // Dead worker found — deregister it.
   719	            match self.registry.deregister(&entry.id) {
   720	                Ok(()) => {
   721	                    tracing::info!(
   722	                        worker_id = %entry.id,
   723	                        pid = entry.pid,
   724	                        "removed dead worker from registry"
   725	                    );
   726	
   727	                    let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendWorkerDeregistered {
   728	                        worker_id: entry.id.clone(),
   729	                        pid: entry.pid,
   730	                    });
   731	
   732	                    summary.workers_deregistered += 1;
   733	                }
   734	                Err(e) => {
   735	                    tracing::warn!(
   736	                        worker_id = %entry.id,
   737	                        error = %e,
   738	                        "failed to deregister dead worker"
   739	                    );
   740	                }
   741	            }
   742	        }
   743	
   744	        Ok(())
   745	    }
   746	
   747	    // ── Step 4: Agent log file cleanup ──────────────────────────────────────
   748	
   749	    /// Delete `.agent.jsonl` files in `log_dir` that are older than
   750	    /// `retention_days` and do not belong to a currently-executing bead.
   751	    ///
   752	    /// Also deletes logs from workers that processed 0 beads immediately,
   753	    /// regardless of age. This cleans up logs from workers that crashed
   754	    /// before processing any beads.
   755	    ///
   756	    /// Files are matched by the `.agent.jsonl` suffix. The bead ID is parsed
   757	    /// from the stem (`<worker>-<bead>`): a file is considered active if the
   758	    /// stem ends with `-<bead_id}` for any in-progress bead.
   759	    async fn cleanup_old_agent_logs(
   760	        &self,
   761	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
   762	        summary: &mut MendSummary,
   763	    ) -> Result<()> {
   764	        if self.retention_days == 0 {
   765	            return Ok(());
   766	        }
   767	
   768	        let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(&self.log_dir) {
   769	            Ok(e) => e,
   770	            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
   771	            Err(e) => {
   772	                tracing::warn!(
   773	                    dir = %self.log_dir.display(),
   774	                    error = %e,
   775	                    "mend: failed to read log directory for agent log cleanup"
   776	                );
   777	                return Ok(());
   778	            }
   779	        };
   780	
   781	        // Collect all .agent.jsonl paths first so we can bail early if none.
   782	        let agent_log_paths: Vec<PathBuf> = entries
   783	            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
   784	            .map(|e| e.path())
   785	            .filter(|p| {
   786	                p.file_name()
   787	                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
   788	                    .map(|n| n.ends_with(".agent.jsonl"))
   789	                    .unwrap_or(false)
   790	            })
   791	            .collect();
   792	
   793	        if agent_log_paths.is_empty() {
   794	            return Ok(());
   795	        }
   796	
   797	        let cutoff = Duration::from_secs(u64::from(self.retention_days) * 86400);
   798	
   799	        // Build the set of currently in-progress bead IDs.
   800	        let in_progress_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = store
   801	            .list_all()
   802	            .await?
   803	            .into_iter()
   804	            .filter(|b| b.status == BeadStatus::InProgress)
   805	            .map(|b| b.id.as_ref().to_string())
   806	            .collect();
   807	
   808	        // Get the registry workers for zero-activity detection.
   809	        let registry_workers = self.registry.list()?;
   810	
   811	        for path in &agent_log_paths {
   812	            // Skip if this log belongs to an in-progress bead.
   813	            let stem = match path
   814	                .file_name()
   815	                .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
   816	                .and_then(|n| n.strip_suffix(".agent.jsonl"))
   817	            {
   818	                Some(s) => s.to_string(),
   819	                None => continue,
   820	            };
   821	
   822	            let is_active = in_progress_ids
   823	                .iter()
   824	                .any(|bead_id| stem == *bead_id || stem.ends_with(&format!("-{bead_id}")));
   825	
   826	            if is_active {
   827	                tracing::debug!(
   828	                    path = %path.display(),
   829	                    "skipping agent log for in-progress bead"
   830	                );
   831	                continue;
   832	            }
   833	
   834	            // Extract worker ID from stem. Format is "{worker_id}-{bead_id}".
   835	            // Worker IDs may contain dashes, so we try to find a match in the registry
   836	            // by checking if any registered worker_id is a prefix of the stem.
   837	            let worker_id = registry_workers
   838	                .iter()
   839	                .find(|w| {
   840	                    // Stem format: "{worker_id}-{bead_id}"
   841	                    // If worker_id is a prefix of stem followed by a dash, it's a match.
   842	                    stem.starts_with(&format!("{}-", w.id))
   843	                })
   844	                .map(|w| w.id.clone());
   845	
   846	            // Check if this is a zero-activity worker log.
   847	            let is_zero_activity = match worker_id {
   848	                Some(ref id) => {
   849	                    // Found in registry — check beads_processed count.
   850	                    registry_workers
   851	                        .iter()
   852	                        .find(|w| &w.id == id)
   853	                        .map(|w| w.beads_processed == 0)
   854	                        .unwrap_or(true)
   855	                }
   856	                None => {
   857	                    // Worker not in registry — treat as zero-activity (crashed before registering).
   858	                    true
   859	                }
   860	            };
   861	
   862	            if is_zero_activity {
   863	                // Delete immediately regardless of age.
   864	                if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_file(path) {
   865	                    tracing::warn!(
   866	                        path = %path.display(),
   867	                        error = %e,
   868	                        "mend: failed to remove zero-activity agent log"
   869	                    );
   870	                    continue;
   871	                }
   872	
   873	                tracing::info!(
   874	                    path = %path.display(),
   875	                    worker_id = ?worker_id,
   876	                    "mend: removed zero-activity agent log"
   877	                );
   878	                summary.zero_activity_logs_cleaned += 1;
   879	
   880	                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendZeroActivityLogCleaned {
   881	                    worker_id: worker_id.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string()),
   882	                    log_path: path.display().to_string(),
   883	                });
   884	                continue;
   885	            }
   886	
   887	            // Check file age for retention-based cleanup.
   888	            let age = match file_age(path) {
   889	                Some(a) => a,
   890	                None => continue,
   891	            };
   892	
   893	            if age <= cutoff {
   894	                continue;
   895	            }
   896	
   897	            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_file(path) {
   898	                tracing::warn!(
   899	                    path = %path.display(),
   900	                    error = %e,
   901	                    "mend: failed to remove stale agent log"
   902	                );
   903	                continue;
   904	            }
   905	
   906	            tracing::info!(
   907	                path = %path.display(),
   908	                age_secs = age.as_secs(),
   909	                "mend: removed stale agent log"
   910	            );
   911	            summary.agent_logs_cleaned += 1;
   912	        }
   913	
   914	        Ok(())
   915	    }
   916	
   917	    // ── Step 4.5: Trace retention cleanup ───────────────────────────────────────
   918	
   919	    /// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.
   920	    ///
   921	    /// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after trace_retention_failed_days
   922	    /// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after trace_retention_success_days, keep metadata only
   923	    fn cleanup_old_traces(&self, summary: &mut MendSummary) -> Result<()> {
   924	        if !self.traces_dir.exists() {
   925	            return Ok(());
   926	        }
   927	
   928	        match cleanup_traces(
   929	            &self.traces_dir,
   930	            self.trace_retention_failed_days,
   930	            self.trace_retention_failed_days,
   931	            self.trace_retention_success_days,
   932	        ) {
   933	            Ok(cleanup_summary) => {
   934	                summary.traces_pruned = cleanup_summary.traces_pruned;
   935	                summary.traces_cleaned = cleanup_summary.traces_deleted;
   936	
   937	                if cleanup_summary.traces_pruned > 0 || cleanup_summary.traces_deleted > 0 {
   938	                    let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendTraceCleanup {
   939	                        traces_pruned: cleanup_summary.traces_pruned,
   940	                        traces_deleted: cleanup_summary.traces_deleted,
   941	                    });
   942	
   943	                    tracing::info!(
   944	                        traces_pruned = cleanup_summary.traces_pruned,
   945	                        traces_deleted = cleanup_summary.traces_deleted,
   946	                        "mend: cleaned up old traces"
   947	                    );
   948	                }
   949	            }
   950	            Err(e) => {
   951	                tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: trace cleanup failed");
   952	            }
   953	        }
   954	
   955	        Ok(())
   956	    }
   957	
   958	    // ── Step 4.75: Learning consolidation ───────────────────────────────────────
   959	
   960	    /// Clean up and consolidate workspace learnings.
   961	    ///
   962	    /// 1. Prune stale entries (>90 days without reinforcement)
   963	    /// 2. Consolidate if entries exceed max_learnings
   964	    fn cleanup_learnings(&self, summary: &mut MendSummary) -> Result<()> {
   965	        let mut learnings = match LearningsFile::load(&self.workspace) {
   966	            Ok(l) => l,
   967	            Err(e) => {
   968	                tracing::debug!(error = %e, "mend: no learnings file to clean up");
   969	                return Ok(());
   970	            }
   971	        };
   972	
   973	        let _original_count = learnings.entries().len();
   974	
   975	        // Step 1: Prune stale entries
   976	        match learnings.prune_stale() {
   977	            Ok(pruned) => {
   978	                if pruned > 0 {
   979	                    tracing::info!(pruned, "mend: pruned stale learning entries");
   980	                    summary.learnings_pruned = pruned as u32;
   981	                }
   982	            }
   983	            Err(e) => {
   984	                tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: failed to prune stale learnings");
   985	            }
   986	        }
   987	
   988	        // Step 2: Consolidate if over limit
   989	        if learnings.entries().len() > self.max_learnings {
   990	            match learnings.consolidate(self.max_learnings) {
   991	                Ok(removed) => {
   992	                    if removed > 0 {
   993	                        tracing::info!(
   994	                            removed,
   995	                            max_count = self.max_learnings,
   996	                            "mend: consolidated learning entries"
   997	                        );
   998	                        summary.learnings_consolidated = removed as u32;
   999	                    }
  1000	                }
  1001	                Err(e) => {
  1002	                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: failed to consolidate learnings");
  1003	                }
  1004	            }
  1005	        }
  1006	
  1007	        if summary.learnings_pruned > 0 || summary.learnings_consolidated > 0 {
  1008	            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendLearningCleanup {
  1009	                pruned: summary.learnings_pruned,
  1010	                consolidated: summary.learnings_consolidated,
  1011	            });
  1012	        }
  1013	
  1014	        Ok(())
  1015	    }
  1016	
  1017	    // ── Step 5: Database health check with auto-recovery ────────────────────
  1018	
  1019	    // ── Step 4.8: Idle worker flagging ─────────────────────────────────────────
  1020	
  1021	    /// Flag workers that have been registered longer than `idle_timeout` with
  1022	    /// zero beads processed. This helps identify workers that may have failed
  1023	    /// to start, are stuck in dispatch, or have agent adapter problems.
  1024	    ///
  1025	    /// This is a warning/telemetry-only operation — idle workers are NOT
  1026	    /// deregistered (they may be genuinely waiting for work).
  1027	    fn flag_idle_workers(&self, summary: &mut MendSummary) -> Result<()> {
  1028	        let workers = self.registry.list()?;
  1029	
  1030	        for worker in workers {
  1031	            // Skip workers that have processed at least one bead.
  1032	            if worker.beads_processed > 0 {
  1033	                continue;
  1034	            }
  1035	
  1036	            // Calculate worker age from started_at.
  1037	            let age = match Utc::now().signed_duration_since(worker.started_at).to_std() {
  1038	                Ok(d) => d,
  1039	                Err(_) => {
  1040	                    tracing::warn!(
  1041	                        worker_id = %worker.id,
  1042	                        "worker started_at is in the future, skipping idle check"
  1043	                    );
  1044	                    continue;
  1045	                }
  1046	            };
  1047	
  1048	            let idle_timeout = Duration::from_secs(self.config.idle_timeout);
  1049	
  1050	            if age > idle_timeout {
  1051	                let age_secs = age.as_secs();
  1052	                tracing::warn!(
  1053	                    worker_id = %worker.id,
  1054	                    pid = worker.pid,
  1055	                    age_secs,
  1056	                    idle_timeout_secs = self.config.idle_timeout,
  1057	                    "flagging idle worker (0 beads processed for longer than idle_timeout)"
  1058	                );
  1059	
  1060	                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendIdleWorkerFlagged {
  1061	                    worker_id: worker.id.clone(),
  1062	                    pid: worker.pid,
  1063	                    age_secs,
  1064	                });
  1065	
  1066	                summary.idle_workers_flagged += 1;
  1067	            }
  1068	        }
  1069	
  1070	        Ok(())
  1071	    }

  1119	
  1120	            // Check if provider exists in config.

   561	/// Resolve an executable against the current `PATH` without process-global
   562	/// caching. Backend selection is workspace-scoped, and tests and embedders may
   563	/// intentionally resolve different environments in one NEEDLE process.
   564	fn find_on_path(binary: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
   565	    let path = std::env::var_os("PATH").ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("PATH is not set"))?;
   566	    std::env::split_paths(&path)
   567	        .map(|directory| directory.join(binary))
   568	        .find(|candidate| is_executable(candidate))
   569	        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("{binary} not found on PATH"))
   570	}
   571	
   572	#[cfg(unix)]
   573	fn is_executable(path: &Path) -> bool {
   574	    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
   575	
   576	    path.metadata()
   577	        .map(|metadata| metadata.is_file() && metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o111 != 0)
   578	        .unwrap_or(false)
   579	}
   580	
   581	#[cfg(not(unix))]
   582	fn is_executable(path: &Path) -> bool {
   583	    path.is_file()
   584	}
   585	
   586	/// Detect the backend type from a binary path.
   587	///
   588	/// Infers the backend from the filename: "bf" selects bead-forge; every other
   589	/// name selects bead-rs.
   590	fn detect_backend_from_path(path: &Path) -> Result<Backend> {
   591	    let file_name = path
   592	        .file_name()
   593	        .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
   594	        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("invalid binary path: no filename"))?;
   595	
   596	    match file_name {
   597	        "bf" => Ok(Backend::Bf),
   598	        _ => Ok(Backend::Bead), // Default to Bead for unknown names
   599	    }
   600	}

     1	//! Abstract bead store interface and CLI implementations.
     2	//!
     3	//! NEEDLE interacts with beads exclusively through the `BeadStore` trait. The
     4	//! default implementation shells out to `bf` (bead-forge) with `--json` output.
     5	//! JSON parsing failures are explicit errors — never silently treated as empty
     6	//! results (v1 bug).
     7	//!
     8	//! The trait is `Send + Sync` because it is called from async worker tasks.
     9	//!
    10	//! `CliBeadStore` binds one backend descriptor to one executable, preventing
    11	//! command grammar and binary identity from being mixed accidentally.
    12	//!
    13	//! IMPORTANT: authors of the `bead-rs`/beads_rust descriptor must probe the
    14	//! actual beads_rust binary (including its help and output), not infer its
    15	//! dialect from this module, `CliBeadStore`, or the bead-forge descriptor.
    16	//!
    17	//! Depends on: `types`.
    18	
    19	mod backend;
    20	mod cli_store;
    21	mod strategies;
    22	
    23	use std::collections::HashSet;
    24	use std::path::Path;
    25	use std::path::PathBuf;
    26	use std::sync::Arc;
    27	
    28	use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
    29	use async_trait::async_trait;
    30	
    31	use crate::types::{Bead, BeadId, ClaimResult};
    32	use tracing::{debug, warn};
    33	
    34	// Re-export the implementations so consumers don't need to change their imports

    36	    builtin_bead_backends, load_bead_backends, BeadBackend, BeadBackendCapabilities,

    41	/// Open the bead store explicitly bound by the target workspace's resolved
    42	/// configuration. This is the production entry point: executable discovery
    43	/// alone is never treated as evidence of store ownership.
    44	pub fn open_configured(
    45	    config: &crate::config::BeadCliConfig,
    46	    workspace: PathBuf,
    47	    model: Option<String>,
    48	    harness: Option<String>,
    49	    harness_version: Option<String>,
    50	) -> Result<Arc<dyn BeadStore>> {
    51	    if matches!(config.backend, crate::config::BeadBackend::Auto) {
    52	        bail!(
    53	            "workspace {} has no authoritative bead backend binding; set bead_cli.backend in {}",
    54	            workspace.display(),
    55	            workspace.join(".needle.yaml").display()
    56	        );
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    let (backend, binary) = crate::config::resolve_bead_cli(config).with_context(|| {
    60	        format!(
    61	            "failed to resolve bead_cli.backend for workspace {}",
    62	            workspace.display()
    63	        )
    64	    })?;
    65	    verify_backend_identity(&backend, &binary, &workspace)?;
    66	    if backend == crate::config::Backend::Bead {
    67	        verify_bead_rs_capabilities(&binary, &workspace)?;
    68	    }
    69	
    70	    match backend {
    71	        crate::config::Backend::Bf => {
    72	            let descriptor = builtin_bead_backends()
    73	                .into_iter()
    74	                .find(|candidate| candidate.name == "bead-forge")
    75	                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("built-in bead-forge descriptor is missing"))?;
    76	            Ok(Arc::new(CliBeadStore::new(
    77	                descriptor,
    78	                binary,
    79	                workspace,
    80	                model,
    81	                harness,
    82	                harness_version,
    83	            )?))
    84	        }
    85	        crate::config::Backend::Bead => {
    86	            let descriptor = builtin_bead_backends()
    87	                .into_iter()
    88	                .find(|candidate| candidate.name == "bead-rs")
    89	                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("built-in bead-rs descriptor is missing"))?;
    90	            Ok(Arc::new(CliBeadStore::new(
    91	                descriptor,
    92	                binary,
    93	                workspace,
    94	                model,
    95	                harness,
    96	                harness_version,
    97	            )?))
    98	        }
    99	    }
   100	}

    88	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    89	// BeadStatus
    90	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    91	
    92	/// Lifecycle status of a bead in the store.
    93	#[non_exhaustive]
    94	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    95	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    96	pub enum BeadStatus {
    97	    Open,
    98	    InProgress,
    99	    /// `bf` (bead-forge) has been observed emitting `"completed"` for done
   100	    /// beads on some workspaces (bf's own `Status` enum has no `Completed`
   101	    /// variant — it falls through to an untagged `Custom(String)`, so this
   102	    /// slips through bf-side validation). Accept it as an alias so a single
   103	    /// such bead doesn't fail `bf list --json` deserialization for every
   104	    /// other bead in the same call — see needle-weave-completed-status.
   105	    #[serde(alias = "completed")]
   106	    Done,
   107	    /// `br show --json` emits `"closed"` for done beads. Treat as equivalent
   108	    /// to `Done` so deserialization succeeds.
   109	    Closed,
   110	    Blocked,
   111	    /// `bf` (bead-forge) emits `"deferred"` for beads deliberately postponed
   112	    /// rather than blocked by a dependency. Distinct from `Blocked`: a
   113	    /// deferred bead has no unmet dependency, it was just set aside — see
   114	    /// GitHub issue jedarden/NEEDLE#10. Without this variant, `bf list --json`
   115	    /// fails deserialization for every such bead, and it silently disappears
   116	    /// from strand/supervise visibility with no surfaced error.
   117	    Deferred,
   118	}
   119	
   120	impl BeadStatus {
   121	    /// Returns true if the bead is finished (either `Done` or `Closed`).
   122	    pub fn is_done(&self) -> bool {
   123	        matches!(self, BeadStatus::Done | BeadStatus::Closed)
   124	    }
   125	}
   126	
   127	impl fmt::Display for BeadStatus {
   128	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
   129	        match self {
   130	            BeadStatus::Open => write!(f, "open"),
   131	            BeadStatus::InProgress => write!(f, "in_progress"),
   132	            BeadStatus::Done | BeadStatus::Closed => write!(f, "done"),
   133	            BeadStatus::Blocked => write!(f, "blocked"),
   134	            BeadStatus::Deferred => write!(f, "deferred"),
   135	        }
   136	    }
   137	}

   139	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   140	// WorkerState
   141	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   142	
   143	/// Worker finite-state-machine states.
   144	///
   145	/// Every state has defined entry conditions, actions, and exit transitions.
   146	/// There are no implicit states or fallthrough paths.
   147	#[non_exhaustive]
   148	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   149	#[serde(rename_all = "SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE")]
   150	pub enum WorkerState {
   151	    Booting,
   152	    Selecting,
   153	    Claiming,
   154	    Retrying,
   155	    Building,
   156	    Dispatching,
   157	    Executing,
   158	    Handling,
   159	    Logging,
   160	    /// All strands returned empty — worker has nothing to do.
   161	    Exhausted,
   162	    /// Received graceful shutdown signal.
   163	    Stopped,
   164	    /// Unrecoverable error.
   165	    Errored,
   166	}
   167	
   168	impl fmt::Display for WorkerState {
   169	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
   170	        let s = match self {

   172	            WorkerState::Selecting => "SELECTING",
   173	            WorkerState::Claiming => "CLAIMING",
   174	            WorkerState::Retrying => "RETRYING",
   175	            WorkerState::Building => "BUILDING",
   176	            WorkerState::Dispatching => "DISPATCHING",
   177	            WorkerState::Executing => "EXECUTING",
   178	            WorkerState::Handling => "HANDLING",
   179	            WorkerState::Logging => "LOGGING",
   180	            WorkerState::Exhausted => "EXHAUSTED",

  1246	    /// Run `br doctor` to check database health. If issues are found,
  1247	    /// escalate through the recovery pipeline:
  1248	    ///
  1249	    /// 1. `br doctor` (check only) → if warnings found:
  1250	    /// 2. `br doctor --repair` → if fails:
  1251	    /// 3. Full rebuild (rm .beads/beads.db + br sync --import + verify)
  1252	    ///
  1253	    /// If the full rebuild also fails, the JSONL itself may be corrupt.
  1254	    async fn check_db_health(
  1255	        &self,
  1256	        store: &dyn BeadStore,
  1257	        summary: &mut MendSummary,
  1258	    ) -> Result<()> {
  1259	        // Step 1: Probe with `br doctor` (no repair).
  1260	        let check_result = store.doctor_check().await;
  1261	
  1262	        let needs_repair = match check_result {
  1263	            Ok(report) => {
  1264	                // Doctor succeeded. If there are warnings, escalate to repair.
  1265	                !report.warnings.is_empty()
  1266	            }
  1267	            Err(e) => {
  1268	                let msg = format!("{e:#}");
  1269	                if store.is_corruption_error(&msg) {
  1270	                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, "bead backend doctor detected corruption");
  1271	                    true
  1272	                } else {
  1273	                    // Non-corruption error (e.g., br not found). Propagate.
  1274	                    return Err(e);
  1275	                }
  1276	            }
  1277	        };
  1278	
  1279	        if !needs_repair {
  1280	            return Ok(());
  1281	        }
  1282	
  1283	        // Step 2: Try `br doctor --repair`.
  1284	        tracing::info!("database health check found issues, attempting repair");
  1285	        match store.doctor_repair().await {
  1286	            Ok(report) => {
  1287	                let warnings = report.warnings.len() as u32;
  1288	                let fixed = report.fixed.len() as u32;
  1289	                tracing::info!(warnings, fixed, "br doctor --repair completed");
  1290	
  1291	                let _ = self
  1292	                    .telemetry
  1293	                    .emit(EventKind::MendDbRepaired { warnings, fixed });
  1294	
  1295	                // Only mark as repaired if actual fixes were applied.
  1296	                // If warnings persist without fixes, returning WorkCreated would
  1297	                // cause an infinite restart loop without making progress.
  1298	                if fixed > 0 {
  1299	                    summary.db_repaired = true;
  1300	                    return Ok(());
  1301	                }
  1302	
  1303	                // If doctor_repair succeeded but warnings persist without fixes,
  1304	                // escalate to full rebuild. This prevents repeated Mend cycles
  1305	                // where each evaluation calls doctor_repair which returns the
  1306	                // same unfixed warnings without making progress.
  1307	                if !report.warnings.is_empty() {
  1308	                    tracing::warn!(
  1309	                        warnings,
  1310	                        "doctor --repair succeeded but warnings persist without fixes, escalating to full rebuild"
  1311	                    );
  1312	                } else {
  1313	                    // No warnings and no fixes - DB is clean, no work needed.
  1314	                    return Ok(());
  1315	                }
  1316	            }
  1317	            Err(e) => {
  1318	                tracing::warn!(
  1319	                    error = %e,
  1320	                    "br doctor --repair failed, attempting full rebuild"
  1321	                );
  1322	            }
  1323	        }
  1324	
  1325	        // Step 3: Full rebuild — rm db + br sync --import + verify.
  1326	        match store.full_rebuild().await {
  1327	            Ok(()) => {
  1328	                tracing::info!("database fully rebuilt from JSONL");
  1329	
  1330	                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendDbRebuilt);
  1331	
  1332	                summary.db_rebuilt = true;
  1333	                Ok(())
  1334	            }
  1335	            Err(e) => {
  1336	                tracing::error!(
  1337	                    error = %e,
  1338	                    "full database rebuild failed — JSONL may be corrupt"
  1339	                );
  1340	                Err(e)
  1341	            }
  1342	        }
  1343	    }
  1344	}

  1357	            needle.strand.result = tracing::field::Empty,
  1358	            needle.strand.duration_ms = tracing::field::Empty,
  1359	        )
  1360	    )]
  1361	    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>) -> StrandResult {
  1362	        let start = std::time::Instant::now();
  1363	        let mut summary = MendSummary::default();
  1364	
  1365	        // Check if the home bead store exists. If not, skip this strand.
  1366	        // This distinguishes between "no home store configured" (expected for
  1367	        // roam-only workers) and "home store is broken" (unexpected error).
  1368	        if !store.has_valid_store() {
  1369	            tracing::info!(
  1370	                "Home workspace has no .beads/ directory — skipping Mend strand \
  1371	                 (expected for roam-only workers)"
  1372	            );
  1373	            return StrandResult::Skipped {
  1374	                reason: "no_home_store".to_string(),
  1375	            };
  1376	        }
  1377	
  1378	        // Step 1: Stale claim cleanup via peer monitoring.
  1379	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_stale_claims(store, &mut summary).await {
  1380	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: stale claim cleanup failed");
  1381	            return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));
  1382	        }
  1383	
  1384	        // Step 1.5: Agent log file cleanup.
  1385	        // Must run BEFORE orphaned in-progress cleanup so that logs for in-progress
  1386	        // beads are preserved (they're still InProgress when we check).
  1387	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_old_agent_logs(store, &mut summary).await {
  1388	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: agent log cleanup failed");
  1389	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1390	        }
  1390	        }
  1391	
  1392	        // Step 2: Orphaned in-progress bead recovery (registry-based).
  1393	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_orphaned_in_progress(store, &mut summary).await {
  1394	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: orphaned in-progress cleanup failed");
  1395	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1396	        }
  1397	
  1398	        // Step 2.3: Stale assignee cleanup on open beads.
  1399	        if let Err(e) = self
  1400	            .cleanup_stale_assignees_on_open_beads(store, &mut summary)
  1401	            .await
  1402	        {
  1403	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: stale assignee cleanup failed");
  1404	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1405	        }
  1406	
  1407	        // Step 2.5: Orphaned heartbeat file removal.
  1408	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_orphaned_heartbeats(&mut summary) {
  1409	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: orphaned heartbeat cleanup failed");
  1410	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1411	        }
  1412	
  1413	        // Step 3: Orphaned lock file removal.
  1414	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_orphaned_locks(&mut summary) {
  1415	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: orphaned lock cleanup failed");
  1416	            return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));
  1417	        }
  1418	
  1419	        // Step 4: Dependency link repair.
  1420	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_stale_dependencies(store, &mut summary).await {
  1421	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: dependency cleanup failed");
  1422	            return StrandResult::Error(StrandError::StoreError(e));
  1423	        }
  1424	
  1425	        // Step 4.5: Dead worker registry cleanup.
  1426	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_dead_workers(&mut summary) {
  1427	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: dead worker cleanup failed");
  1428	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1429	        }
  1430	
  1431	        // Step 5: Trace retention cleanup.
  1432	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_old_traces(&mut summary) {
  1433	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: trace cleanup failed");
  1434	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1435	        }
  1436	
  1437	        // Step 5.5: Learning consolidation.
  1438	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_learnings(&mut summary) {
  1439	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: learning cleanup failed");
  1440	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1441	        }
  1442	
  1443	        // Step 5.75: Idle worker flagging.
  1444	        if let Err(e) = self.flag_idle_workers(&mut summary) {
  1445	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: idle worker flagging failed");
  1446	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1447	        }
  1448	
  1449	        // Step 5.875: Rate limiter state cleanup.
  1450	        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_rate_limit_state(&mut summary) {
  1451	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: rate limit state cleanup failed");
  1452	            // Non-fatal — continue with remaining steps.
  1453	        }
  1454	
  1455	        // Step 6: Database health check.
  1456	        if let Err(e) = self.check_db_health(store, &mut summary).await {
  1457	            tracing::warn!(error = %e, "mend: database health check failed");
  1458	            // DB check failure is non-fatal — continue with the summary.
  1459	        }
  1460	
  1461	        // Emit cycle summary telemetry.
  1462	        let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendCycleSummary {
  1463	            beads_released: summary.beads_released,
  1464	            locks_removed: summary.locks_removed,
  1465	            deps_cleaned: summary.deps_cleaned,
  1466	            db_repaired: summary.db_repaired,
  1467	            db_rebuilt: summary.db_rebuilt,
  1468	            agent_logs_cleaned: summary.agent_logs_cleaned,
  1469	            zero_activity_logs_cleaned: summary.zero_activity_logs_cleaned,
  1470	            traces_pruned: summary.traces_pruned,
  1471	            traces_deleted: summary.traces_cleaned,
  1472	            workers_deregistered: summary.workers_deregistered,
  1473	            idle_workers_flagged: summary.idle_workers_flagged,
  1474	            rate_limits_cleaned: summary.rate_limits_cleaned,
  1475	            assignees_cleared: summary.assignees_cleared,
  1476	        });
  1477	
  1478	        let result = if summary.did_work() {
  1479	            tracing::info!(
  1480	                beads_released = summary.beads_released,
  1481	                locks_removed = summary.locks_removed,
  1482	                deps_cleaned = summary.deps_cleaned,
  1483	                db_repaired = summary.db_repaired,
  1484	                db_rebuilt = summary.db_rebuilt,
  1485	                agent_logs_cleaned = summary.agent_logs_cleaned,
  1486	                traces_pruned = summary.traces_pruned,
  1487	                traces_deleted = summary.traces_cleaned,
  1488	                "mend performed cleanup — restarting waterfall"
  1489	            );
  1490	            StrandResult::WorkCreated
  1491	        } else {
  1492	            tracing::debug!("mend found nothing to clean");
  1493	            StrandResult::NoWork
  1494	        };
  1495	
  1496	        // Record result and duration on the span
  1497	        let duration_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
  1498	        tracing::Span::current().record("needle.strand.result", format!("{:?}", result));
  1499	        tracing::Span::current().record("needle.strand.duration_ms", duration_ms);
  1500	
  1501	        result
  1502	    }
  1503	}

  1509	/// Get the age of a file based on its modification time.
  1510	fn file_age(path: &Path) -> Option<Duration> {
  1511	    let metadata = std::fs::metadata(path).ok()?;
  1512	    let modified = metadata.modified().ok()?;
  1513	    SystemTime::now().duration_since(modified).ok()
  1514	}
  1515	
  1516	/// Try to acquire an exclusive flock on a file (non-blocking).
  1517	///
  1518	/// Returns `Ok(Some(file))` if acquired, `Ok(None)` if held by another process.
  1519	fn try_acquire_flock(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<std::fs::File>> {
  1520	    use fs2::FileExt;
  1521	
  1522	    let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
  1523	        .read(true)
  1524	        .write(true)
  1525	        .open(path)?;
  1526	
  1527	    match file.try_lock_exclusive() {
  1528	        Ok(()) => Ok(Some(file)),
  1529	        Err(ref e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => Ok(None),
  1530	        Err(e) => Err(e.into()),
  1531	    }
  1532	}

  2620	/// Supervisor detection configuration.
  2621	///
  2622	/// Controls how NEEDLE detects whether it's running under a supervisor process.
  2623	/// Supervisor detection is used for graceful shutdown coordination, resource cleanup,
  2624	/// and inter-process communication between workers and the supervisor.
  2625	///
  2626	/// ## Detection Mechanism
  2627	///
  2628	/// The supervisor process writes a heartbeat file at a regular interval to signal liveness.
  2629	/// Workers monitor this file to determine if the supervisor is still running.
  2630	/// If the file is missing or stale, workers may initiate graceful shutdown procedures.
  2631	///
  2632	/// ## Environment Variables
  2633	///
  2634	/// The following environment variables can override config file settings:
  2635	///
  2636	/// - `NEEDLE_SUPERVISOR_HEARTBEAT_PATH`: Path to the supervisor's heartbeat file
  2637	/// - `NEEDLE_SUPERVISOR_SOCKET_PATH`: Path to the supervisor's control socket (Unix domain socket)
  2638	///
  2639	/// ## Configuration Example
  2640	///
  2641	/// ```yaml
  2642	/// supervisor_detection:
  2643	///   heartbeat_path: ~/.needle/state/supervisor-heartbeat.json
  2644	///   socket_path: ~/.needle/supervisor.sock
  2645	/// ```
  2645	/// ```
  2646	///
  2647	/// ## Fields
  2648	///
  2649	/// - **heartbeat_path**: Path to the supervisor's heartbeat file for liveness detection
  2650	/// - **socket_path**: Optional Unix domain socket path for supervisor IPC
  2651	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
  2652	pub struct SupervisorDetectionConfig {
  2653	    /// Path to the supervisor's heartbeat file.
  2654	    ///
  2655	    /// The supervisor writes this file at a regular interval to signal liveness.
  2656	    /// Workers check this file to determine if the supervisor is still running.
  2657	    /// If the file is missing or stale, workers may initiate graceful shutdown.
  2658	    ///
  2659	    /// **Environment Variable**: `NEEDLE_SUPERVISOR_HEARTBEAT_PATH`
  2660	    ///
  2661	    /// # Example
  2662	    ///
  2663	    /// ```yaml
  2664	    /// supervisor_detection:
  2665	    ///   heartbeat_path: ~/.needle/state/supervisor-heartbeat.json
  2666	    /// ```
  2667	    pub heartbeat_path: PathBuf,
  2668	
  2669	    /// Path to the supervisor's control socket (Unix domain socket).
  2670	    ///
  2671	    /// Some supervisors use a control socket for IPC. If set, workers can use
  2672	    /// this socket to send status updates or receive commands from the supervisor.
  2673	    ///
  2674	    /// **Environment Variable**: `NEEDLE_SUPERVISOR_SOCKET_PATH`
  2675	    ///
  2676	    /// When `None`, no socket-based communication is available.
  2677	    ///
  2678	    /// # Example
  2679	    ///
  2680	    /// ```yaml
  2681	    /// supervisor_detection:
  2682	    ///   socket_path: ~/.needle/supervisor.sock
  2683	    /// ```
  2684	    #[serde(default)]
  2685	    pub socket_path: Option<PathBuf>,
  2686	}

   331	    async fn show(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<Bead> {
   332	        let values = HashMap::from([("id", id.to_string())]);
   333	        let stdout = self.run_operation("show", &values).await?;
   334	        self.parse_beads("show", &stdout)?
   335	            .into_iter()
   336	            .next()
   337	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("{} show {} returned no bead", self.backend.name, id))
   338	    }
   339	
   340	    async fn show_with_claim_history(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<(Bead, Option<u32>)> {
   341	        let values = HashMap::from([("id", id.to_string())]);
   342	        let stdout = self.run_operation("show", &values).await?;
   343	        let (bead, claim_events) = self
   344	            .parse_beads_with_claim_history("show", &stdout)?
   345	            .into_iter()
   346	            .next()
   347	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("{} show {} returned no bead", self.backend.name, id))?;
   348	        Ok((bead, claim_events))
   349	    }
   350	
   351	    async fn notes(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<Option<String>> {
   352	        let values = HashMap::from([("id", id.to_string())]);
   353	        let stdout = self.run_operation("show", &values).await?;
   354	        let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(stdout.trim())?;
   355	        let object = value
   356	            .as_array()
   357	            .and_then(|items| items.first())
   358	            .unwrap_or(&value);
   359	        Ok(object
   360	            .get("notes")
   361	            .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
   362	            .map(str::to_string))
   363	    }
   364	
   365	    async fn claim(&self, id: &BeadId, actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {
   366	        if matches!(
   367	            self.strategy("claim")?,
   368	            ParsedStrategy::Claim(ClaimStrategy::BatchOp)
   369	        ) {
   370	            return self.claim_via_batch(id, actor).await;
   371	        }
   372	        let shown = self.show(id).await?;
   373	        if shown.status != BeadStatus::Open {
   374	            return Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {
   375	                reason: format!("bead is {}, not open", shown.status),
   376	            });
   377	        }
   378	        if let Some(claimed_by) = shown.assignee {
   379	            return Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost { claimed_by });
   380	        }
   381	
   382	        // bead-rs exposes its monotonic revision in raw `show` JSON. Read the
   383	        // state and revision together, then guard the update with that revision.
   384	        let show_values = HashMap::from([("id", id.to_string())]);
   385	        let raw = self.run_operation("show", &show_values).await?;
   386	        let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(raw.trim())?;
   387	        let value = value
   388	            .as_array()
   389	            .and_then(|items| items.first())
   390	            .unwrap_or(&value);
   391	        if value.get("status").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) != Some("open") {
   392	            return Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {
   393	                reason: "bead changed state before claim".to_string(),
   394	            });
   395	        }
   396	        if let Some(claimed_by) = value.get("assignee").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
   397	            if !claimed_by.is_empty() {
   398	                return Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost {
   399	                    claimed_by: claimed_by.to_string(),
   400	                });
   401	            }
   402	        }
   403	        let revision = value
   404	            .get("revision")
   405	            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
   406	            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("bead-rs show response omitted revision"))?;
   407	        let args = vec![
   408	            "update".to_string(),
   409	            id.to_string(),
   410	            "--status".to_string(),
   411	            "in_progress".to_string(),
   412	            "--assignee".to_string(),
   413	            actor.to_string(),
   414	            "--if-revision".to_string(),
   415	            revision.to_string(),
   416	        ];
   417	        match self.run_argv("claim", &args, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS).await {
   418	            Ok(_) => Ok(ClaimResult::Claimed(self.show(id).await?)),
   419	            Err(error) if error.to_string().contains("code 4") => {
   420	                let latest = self.show(id).await?;
   421	                match latest.assignee {
   422	                    Some(claimed_by) => Ok(ClaimResult::RaceLost { claimed_by }),
   423	                    None => Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {
   424	                        reason: "bead changed during claim".to_string(),
   425	                    }),
   426	                }
   427	            }
   428	            Err(error) => Err(error),
   429	        }
   430	    }

   636	/// A bead as returned from the bead store.
   637	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   638	pub struct Bead {
   639	    pub id: BeadId,
   640	    pub title: String,
   641	    /// Stored as `description` in br JSON output.
   642	    #[serde(rename = "description")]
   643	    pub body: Option<String>,
   644	    pub priority: Priority,
   645	    pub status: BeadStatus,
   646	    /// br emits `""` for unassigned beads; normalize to `None`.
   647	    #[serde(default, deserialize_with = "empty_string_as_none")]
   648	    pub assignee: Option<String>,
   649	    /// br may omit this field when empty.
   650	    #[serde(default)]
   651	    pub labels: Vec<String>,
   652	    /// Stored as `source_repo` in br JSON output.
   653	    #[serde(rename = "source_repo", default)]
   654	    pub workspace: std::path::PathBuf,
   655	    #[serde(default)]
   656	    pub dependencies: Vec<BrDependency>,
   657	    #[serde(default)]
   658	    pub dependents: Vec<BrDependency>,
   659	    /// Comments on this bead, returned by `bf show --json`.
   660	    /// Empty array if no comments or backend doesn't support comments.
   661	    #[serde(default)]
   662	    pub comments: Vec<Comment>,
   663	    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,
   664	    // br ready --json omits updated_at; default to now so explore can deserialize it
   665	    #[serde(default = "chrono::Utc::now")]
   666	    pub updated_at: DateTime<Utc>,
   667	}

     1	//! Peer monitoring — stale claim release and crash cleanup.
     2	//!
     3	//! Detects crashed or stuck workers by reading heartbeat files and comparing
     4	//! them against the configured TTL. For crashed workers (stale heartbeat +
     5	//! dead PID), releases the claimed bead, removes the heartbeat file, and
     6	//! deregisters from the worker registry.
     7	//!
     8	//! This module is designed to be called by the Mend strand (Strand 2). No
     9	//! other strand should perform peer monitoring.
    10	//!
    11	//! Depends on: `bead_store`, `health`, `registry`, `telemetry`, `types`.
    12	
    13	use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
    14	use std::time::Duration;
    15	
    16	use anyhow::{Context, Result};
    17	use chrono::Utc;
    18	
    19	use crate::bead_store::BeadStore;
    20	use crate::health::{HealthMonitor, StalePeer};
    21	use crate::registry::Registry;
    22	use crate::telemetry::{EventKind, Telemetry};

    24	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    25	// PeerCheckResult
    26	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    27	
    28	/// Summary of a peer monitoring check cycle.
    29	#[derive(Debug)]
    30	pub struct PeerCheckResult {
    31	    /// Number of crashed workers detected (dead PID).
    32	    pub crashed_count: u32,
    33	    /// Number of stuck workers detected (alive PID, stale heartbeat).
    34	    pub stuck_count: u32,
    35	    /// Number of beads released from crashed workers.
    36	    pub beads_released: u32,
    37	}
    38	
    39	impl PeerCheckResult {
    40	    /// Whether any cleanup work was performed.
    41	    pub fn did_work(&self) -> bool {
    42	        self.beads_released > 0
    43	    }
    44	}
    45	
    46	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    47	// PeerMonitor
    48	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    49	
    50	/// Monitors peer workers for crashes and stale heartbeats.
    51	///
    52	/// Constructed with references to shared infrastructure (bead store, registry,
    53	/// telemetry). Call `check_peers()` to run one monitoring cycle.
    54	pub struct PeerMonitor<'a> {
    55	    heartbeat_dir: PathBuf,
    56	    heartbeat_ttl: Duration,
    57	    own_worker_id: String,
    58	    store: &'a dyn BeadStore,
    59	    registry: &'a Registry,
    60	    telemetry: Telemetry,
    61	}
    62	
    63	impl<'a> PeerMonitor<'a> {
    64	    /// Create a new peer monitor.
    65	    ///
    66	    /// - `heartbeat_dir`: path to `~/.needle/state/heartbeats/`
    67	    /// - `heartbeat_ttl`: how long before a heartbeat is considered stale
    68	    /// - `own_worker_id`: this worker's ID (excluded from peer checks)
    69	    /// - `store`: bead store for releasing orphaned beads
    70	    /// - `registry`: worker registry for deregistering crashed workers
    71	    /// - `telemetry`: telemetry emitter for peer events
    72	    pub fn new(
    73	        heartbeat_dir: PathBuf,
    74	        heartbeat_ttl: Duration,
    75	        own_worker_id: String,
    76	        store: &'a dyn BeadStore,
    77	        registry: &'a Registry,
    78	        telemetry: Telemetry,
    79	    ) -> Self {
    80	        PeerMonitor {
    81	            heartbeat_dir,
    82	            heartbeat_ttl,
    83	            own_worker_id,
    84	            store,
    85	            registry,
    86	            telemetry,
    87	        }
    88	    }
    89	
    90	    /// Run one peer monitoring cycle.
    91	    ///
    92	    /// Algorithm:
    93	    /// 1. Read all heartbeat files
    94	    /// 2. For each stale peer (excluding ourselves):
    95	    ///    a. If PID is dead → CRASHED: release bead, remove heartbeat, deregister
    96	    ///    b. If PID is alive → STUCK: emit warning only, do NOT release
    97	    /// 3. Return summary of actions taken
    98	    pub async fn check_peers(&self) -> Result<PeerCheckResult> {
    99	        let heartbeats = HealthMonitor::read_all_heartbeats(&self.heartbeat_dir)?;
   100	
   101	        let mut result = PeerCheckResult {
   102	            crashed_count: 0,
   103	            stuck_count: 0,
   104	            beads_released: 0,
   105	        };
   106	
   107	        for hb in &heartbeats {
   108	            // Skip our own heartbeat (match by qualified identity).
   109	            if hb.qualified_id == self.own_worker_id {
   110	                continue;
   111	            }
   112	
   113	            // Only check stale heartbeats.
   114	            if !HealthMonitor::is_stale(hb, self.heartbeat_ttl) {
   115	                continue;
   116	            }
   117	
   118	            let pid_alive = HealthMonitor::check_pid_alive(hb.pid);
   119	            let stale_peer = StalePeer {
   120	                worker_id: hb.worker_id.clone(),
   121	                qualified_id: Some(hb.qualified_id.clone()),
   122	                pid: hb.pid,
   123	                pid_alive,
   124	                current_bead: hb.current_bead.clone(),
   125	                last_heartbeat: hb.last_heartbeat,
   126	                heartbeat_file: hb.heartbeat_file.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
   127	                    self.heartbeat_dir.join(format!("{}.json", hb.qualified_id))
   128	                }),
   129	            };
   130	
   131	            if pid_alive {
   132	                // STUCK: alive PID, stale heartbeat. Warn only — do NOT release.
   133	                self.handle_stuck_peer(&stale_peer)?;
   134	                result.stuck_count += 1;
   135	            } else {
   136	                // CRASHED: dead PID. Clean up.
   137	                let released = self.handle_crashed_peer(&stale_peer).await?;
   138	                result.crashed_count += 1;
   139	                if released {
   140	                    result.beads_released += 1;
   141	                }
   142	            }
   143	        }
   144	
   145	        if result.crashed_count > 0 || result.stuck_count > 0 {
   146	            tracing::info!(
   147	                crashed = result.crashed_count,
   148	                stuck = result.stuck_count,
   149	                beads_released = result.beads_released,
   150	                "peer monitoring cycle complete"
   151	            );
   152	        }
   153	
   154	        Ok(result)
   155	    }
   156	
   157	    /// Handle a stuck peer: alive PID but stale heartbeat.
   158	    ///
   159	    /// Safety: never release the bead, never kill the process. Alert only.
   160	    fn handle_stuck_peer(&self, peer: &StalePeer) -> Result<()> {
   161	        let age_secs = Utc::now()
   162	            .signed_duration_since(peer.last_heartbeat)
   163	            .num_seconds()
   164	            .max(0) as u64;
   165	
   166	        tracing::warn!(
   167	            worker = %peer.worker_id,
   168	            pid = peer.pid,
   169	            age_secs,
   170	            bead = ?peer.current_bead,
   171	            "peer is stuck (alive PID, stale heartbeat) — not releasing"
   172	        );
   173	
   174	        // Emit peer.stale telemetry for each stuck peer.
   175	        if let Some(ref bead_id) = peer.current_bead {
   176	            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::StuckDetected {
   177	                bead_id: bead_id.clone(),
   178	                age_secs,
   179	            })?;
   180	        }
   181	
   182	        Ok(())
   183	    }
   184	
   185	    /// Handle a crashed peer: dead PID, stale heartbeat.
   186	    ///
   187	    /// 1. Release the claimed bead (if any)
   188	    /// 2. Remove the heartbeat file
   189	    /// 3. Deregister from the worker registry
   190	    /// 4. Emit peer.crashed telemetry
   191	    ///
   192	    /// Returns `true` if a bead was released.
   193	    async fn handle_crashed_peer(&self, peer: &StalePeer) -> Result<bool> {
   194	        tracing::info!(
   195	            worker = %peer.worker_id,
   196	            pid = peer.pid,
   197	            bead = ?peer.current_bead,
   198	            "peer crashed — cleaning up"
   199	        );
   200	
   201	        let mut bead_released = false;
   202	
   203	        // 1. Release the claimed bead (if any).
   204	        if let Some(ref bead_id) = peer.current_bead {
   205	            match self.store.release(bead_id).await {
   206	                Ok(()) => {
   207	                    tracing::info!(
   208	                        bead = %bead_id,
   209	                        worker = %peer.worker_id,
   210	                        "released orphaned bead from crashed worker"
   211	                    );
   212	                    bead_released = true;
   213	                }
   214	                Err(e) => {
   215	                    // Release failure is non-fatal — the bead may have already
   216	                    // been released or closed by another path.
   217	                    tracing::warn!(
   218	                        bead = %bead_id,
   219	                        worker = %peer.worker_id,
   220	                        error = %e,
   221	                        "failed to release bead from crashed worker (may already be released)"
   222	                    );
   223	                }
   224	            }
   225	
   226	            // Emit peer.crashed telemetry.
   227	            self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::StuckReleased {
   228	                bead_id: bead_id.clone(),
   229	                peer_worker: peer
   230	                    .qualified_id
   231	                    .as_deref()
   232	                    .unwrap_or(&peer.worker_id)
   233	                    .to_string(),
   234	            })?;
   235	        }
   236	
   237	        // 2. Remove the heartbeat file.
   238	        remove_heartbeat_file(&peer.heartbeat_file)?;
   239	
   240	        // 3. Deregister from the worker registry.
   240	        // 3. Deregister from the worker registry.
   241	        let dereg_id = peer.qualified_id.as_deref().unwrap_or(&peer.worker_id);
   242	        if let Err(e) = self.registry.deregister(dereg_id) {
   243	            tracing::warn!(
   244	                worker = %peer.worker_id,
   245	                error = %e,
   246	                "failed to deregister crashed worker from registry"
   247	            );
   248	        }
   249	
   250	        Ok(bead_released)
   251	    }
   252	}

   255	// Helpers
   256	// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   257	
   258	/// Remove a heartbeat file (best-effort).
   259	fn remove_heartbeat_file(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
   260	    match std::fs::remove_file(path) {
   261	        Ok(()) => {
   262	            tracing::debug!(path = %path.display(), "removed stale heartbeat file");
   263	            Ok(())
   264	        }
   265	        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
   266	            // Already gone — not an error.
   267	            tracing::debug!(path = %path.display(), "heartbeat file already removed");
   268	            Ok(())
   269	        }
   270	        Err(e) => {
   271	            Err(e).with_context(|| format!("failed to remove heartbeat file: {}", path.display()))
   272	        }
   273	    }
   274	}

     1	//! Hierarchical configuration loading and validation.
     2	//!
     3	//! Resolution order (later layers override earlier):
     4	//! 1. Built-in defaults
     5	//! 2. Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`)
     6	//! 3. Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`)
     7	//! 4. Environment variables (`NEEDLE_*`)
     8	//! 5. CLI arguments (highest precedence)
     9	//!
    10	//! Config is loaded once at boot and never reloaded.

    12	//! Leaf module — depends only on `types`.

    29	/// A single routing rule mapping model patterns to adapters.
    30	///
    31	/// Rules are evaluated in order; the first matching rule determines the adapter.
    32	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    33	pub struct RoutingRule {
    34	    /// Regex or glob pattern to match against model names.
    35	    ///
    36	    /// Patterns are matched against the model name only (not provider prefixes).
    37	    /// Examples: `"sonnet"`, `"opus"`, `"claude-sonnet-4-6"`, `"(claude-)?(sonnet|opus).*"`.
    38	    pub match_model: String,
    39	
    40	    /// Adapter to use for matching models (e.g., `claude-print`, `claude-code-glm-4.7`).
    41	    pub adapter: String,
    42	}
    43	
    44	/// Agent routing configuration.
    45	///
    46	/// Maps model name patterns to adapters. When a bead specifies a model,
    47	/// the routing rules are evaluated in order to determine which adapter to use.
    48	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    49	pub struct RoutingConfig {
    50	    /// Ordered list of routing rules (first match wins).
    51	    #[serde(default)]
    52	    pub rules: Vec<RoutingRule>,
    53	
    54	    /// Fallback adapter when no rules match (defaults to `agent.default`).
    55	    #[serde(default)]
    56	    pub default_adapter: Option<String>,
    57	
    58	    /// When true, fail if no routing rule matches instead of falling back.
    59	    ///
    60	    /// If set to true and no rule matches the model:
    61	    /// - The bead dispatch fails immediately
    62	    /// - A `RoutingFailed` telemetry event is emitted
    63	    /// - No fallback to `agent.default` or `default_adapter` occurs
    64	    ///
    65	    /// Default: false (fallback behavior for backward compatibility).
    66	    #[serde(default)]
    67	    pub strict: bool,
    68	}
    69	
    70	/// Process timeout limits configuration.
    71	///
    72	/// Defines timeout parameters for agent process execution, separating
    73	/// timeout configuration from other agent settings.
    74	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    75	pub struct ProcessLimits {
    76	    /// Idle timeout duration (None means disabled).
    77	    ///
    78	    /// When set, the agent process will be terminated if no stdout/stderr
    79	    /// activity occurs for this duration. This prevents hung processes from
    80	    /// blocking indefinitely when they stop producing output but don't exit.
    81	    ///
    82	    /// Set to `None` to disable idle timeout detection (processes can run
    83	    /// indefinitely as long as they produce no output).
    84	    ///
    85	    /// # Examples
    86	    ///
    87	    /// ```yaml
    88	    /// # Disable idle timeout (processes can hang indefinitely)
    89	    /// process_limits:
    90	    ///     idle_timeout: null
    91	    ///
    92	    /// # 5 minute idle timeout
    93	    /// process_limits:
    94	    ///     idle_timeout: 300s
    95	    ///
    96	    /// # 30 second idle timeout
    97	    /// process_limits:
    98	    ///     idle_timeout: 30s
    99	    /// ```
   100	    #[serde(default)]
   101	    pub idle_timeout: Option<u64>,
   102	}

  2220	    alert_cooldown_minutes: 60
  1415	   b. **All beads claimed:** Other workers are busy. Normal contention. Wait.
  1416	   c. **Beads invisible:** Configuration error (wrong workspace, broken filter). Alert.
  1417	3. Return `NoWork` → worker enters EXHAUSTED state with backoff
  1418	
  1419	**Guardrails (from `docs/notes/worker-starvation-lessons.md`):**
  1420	- **Verify independently before alerting.** The v1 system had 100% false positive rate because it used the same broken code path for verification.
  1421	- **Three-state model.** "No work" is three different conditions with different responses. Conflating them caused the false positive spiral.
  1422	- **Rate limit alerts:** Max 1 alert bead per workspace per hour.
  1423	- **Alert includes diagnostics:** Bead counts, worker count, claimed count, config snapshot.
  1424	
  1425	**Exit conditions:**
  1426	| Result | Action |
  1427	|--------|--------|
  1428	| Always | Return `NoWork` → EXHAUSTED state |
  1429
