  1589	        /// doctor_check returns warnings, doctor_repair fails → full rebuild.
  1590	        fn with_repair_failure(mut self) -> Self {
  1591	            self.check_warnings = vec!["corruption detected".to_string()];
  1592	            self.repair_report = None;
  1593	            self.rebuild_fails = false;
  1594	            self
  1595	        }
  1596	
  1597	        /// Everything fails → persistent corruption (ERRORED state).
  1598	        fn with_all_recovery_failure(mut self) -> Self {
  1599	            self.check_warnings = vec!["corruption detected".to_string()];
  1600	            self.repair_report = None;
  1601	            self.rebuild_fails = true;
  1602	            self
  1603	        }
  1604	    }
  1605	
  1606	    #[async_trait]
  1607	    impl BeadStore for MockBeadStore {
  1608	        async fn ready(&self, _filters: &Filters) -> Result<Vec<Bead>> {
  1609	            Ok(vec![])
  1610	        }
  1611	        async fn list_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Bead>> {
  1612	            Ok(self.all_beads.lock().unwrap().clone())
  1613	        }
  1614	        async fn show(&self, _id: &BeadId) -> Result<Bead> {
  1615	            anyhow::bail!("not implemented in mock")
  1616	        }
  1617	        async fn claim(&self, _id: &BeadId, _actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {
  1618	            anyhow::bail!("not implemented in mock")
  1619	        }
  1620	
  1621	        async fn claim_auto(&self, _actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {
  1622	            anyhow::bail!("not implemented in mock")
  1623	        }
  1624	
  1625	        async fn release(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {
  1626	            // Find and update the bead's status, simulating real bead store behavior.
  1627	            let mut beads = self.all_beads.lock().unwrap();
  1628	            if let Some(bead) = beads.iter_mut().find(|b| &b.id == id) {
  1629	                // Only count releases for InProgress beads (real behavior).
  1630	                if bead.status == BeadStatus::InProgress {
  1631	                    bead.status = BeadStatus::Open;
  1632	                    bead.assignee = None;
  1633	                    self.release_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
  1634	                }
  1635	                Ok(())
  1636	            } else {
  1637	                anyhow::bail!("bead not found: {}", id)
  1638	            }
  1639	        }
  1640	        async fn block(&self, _id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {
  1641	            Ok(())
  1642	        }
  1643	        async fn flush(&self) -> Result<()> {
  1644	            Ok(())
  1645	        }
  1646	        async fn reopen(&self, _id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {
  1647	            Ok(())
  1648	        }
  1649	        async fn labels(&self, _id: &BeadId) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
  1650	            Ok(vec![])
  1651	        }
  1652	        async fn add_label(&self, _id: &BeadId, _label: &str) -> Result<()> {
  1653	            Ok(())
  1654	        }
  1655	        async fn remove_label(&self, _id: &BeadId, _label: &str) -> Result<()> {
  1656	            Ok(())
  1657	        }
  1658	        async fn create_bead(&self, _title: &str, _body: &str, _labels: &[&str]) -> Result<BeadId> {
  1659	            Ok(BeadId::from("mock-bead"))
  1660	        }
  1661	        async fn doctor_repair(&self) -> Result<RepairReport> {
  1662	            match &self.repair_report {
  1663	                Some(r) => Ok(RepairReport {
  1664	                    warnings: r.warnings.clone(),
  1665	                    fixed: r.fixed.clone(),
  1666	                }),
  1667	                None => anyhow::bail!("database disk image is malformed"),
  1668	            }
  1669	        }
  1670	        async fn doctor_check(&self) -> Result<RepairReport> {
  1671	            Ok(RepairReport {
  1672	                warnings: self.check_warnings.clone(),
  1673	                fixed: vec![],
  1674	            })
  1675	        }
  1676	        async fn full_rebuild(&self) -> Result<()> {
  1677	            if self.rebuild_fails {
  1678	                anyhow::bail!("full rebuild failed: JSONL corrupt")
  1679	            } else {
  1680	                Ok(())
  1681	            }
  1682	        }
  1683	        async fn add_dependency(&self, _blocker_id: &BeadId, _blocked_id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {
  1684	            Ok(())
  1685	        }
  1686	        async fn remove_dependency(
  1687	            &self,
  1688	            _blocked_id: &BeadId,
  1689	            _blocker_id: &BeadId,
  1690	        ) -> Result<()> {
  1691	            Ok(())
  1692	        }
  1693	        async fn clear_assignee(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {
  1694	            // Find and update the bead's assignee, simulating real bead store behavior.
  1695	            let mut beads = self.all_beads.lock().unwrap();
  1696	            if let Some(bead) = beads.iter_mut().find(|b| &b.id == id) {
  1697	                bead.assignee = None;
  1698	                self.clear_assignee_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
  1699	                Ok(())
  1700	            } else {
  1701	                anyhow::bail!("bead not found: {}", id)
  1702	            }
  1703	        }
  1704	
  1705	        fn has_valid_store(&self) -> bool {
  1706	            true
  1707	        }
  1708	    }

  1925	        let hb_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
  1926	        let lock_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
  1927	        let reg_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
  1928	
  1929	        // Write a stale heartbeat with dead PID.
  1930	        write_heartbeat(
  1931	            hb_dir.path(),
  1932	            &make_stale_heartbeat("dead-worker", 99_999_999, Some("nd-orphan")),
  1933	        );
  1934	
  1935	        // Create an in-progress bead assigned to the dead worker.
  1936	        let bead = make_in_progress_bead("nd-orphan", "dead-worker");
  1937	        let (store, release_count, _) = MockBeadStore::new(vec![bead]);
  1938	        let mend = make_mend_strand(hb_dir.path(), lock_dir.path(), reg_dir.path());
  1939	
  1940	        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;
  1941	        assert!(
  1942	            matches!(result, StrandResult::WorkCreated),
  1943	            "expected WorkCreated after releasing crashed peer's bead, got: {result:?}"
  1944	        );
  1945	        assert_eq!(release_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
  1946	    }

   520	        ) {

   537	                    "blocker": format!("@{index}"),
   538	                }));
   539	            }
   540	            let payload = serde_json::to_string(&operations)?;
   541	            let args = vec!["batch".to_string(), "--json".to_string(), payload];
   542	            let stdout = self.run_argv("split", &args, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECS).await?;
   543	            let ids = parse_batch_created_ids(&stdout);

   547	                    self.backend.name,
   548	                    children.len(),
   549	                    ids.len()
   550	                );
   551	            }
   552	            return Ok(ids);
   553	        }
   554	
   555	        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(children.len());
   556	        for child in children {
   557	            let id = self
   558	                .create_bead(child.title, child.body, child.labels)
   559	                .await?;
   560	            self.add_dependency(&id, parent_id).await?;
   561	            ids.push(id);
   562	        }
   563	        Ok(ids)
   564	    }

   584	    async fn full_rebuild(&self) -> Result<()> {
   585	        if !matches!(self.backend.name.as_str(), "bead-rs" | "bead-forge") {
   586	            bail!(
   587	                "descriptor-driven full rebuild is not enabled for backend '{}'",
   588	                self.backend.name
   589	            );
   590	        }
   591	
   592	        let checkpoint = if self.backend.name == "bead-forge" {
   593	            self.workspace.join(".beads/issues.jsonl")
   594	        } else {
   595	            self.workspace.join(".beads/checkpoint")
   596	        };
   597	        if !checkpoint.exists() {
   598	            bail!(
   599	                "refusing to rebuild backend '{}' without checkpoint {}",
   600	                self.backend.name,
   601	                checkpoint.display()
   602	            );
   603	        }
   604	
   605	        // Keep the complete SQLite file set recoverable until import and
   606	        // doctor verification both succeed. A failed import must never turn a
   607	        // repairable store into an empty or partially initialized one.
   608	        let db_paths = [
   609	            self.workspace.join(".beads/beads.db"),
   610	            self.workspace.join(".beads/beads.db-wal"),
   611	            self.workspace.join(".beads/beads.db-shm"),
   612	        ];
   613	        let backup_paths = db_paths
   614	            .iter()
   615	            .map(|path| {
   616	                path.with_extension(format!(
   617	                    "{}needle-rebuild-backup",
   618	                    path.extension()
   619	                        .and_then(|extension| extension.to_str())
   620	                        .map(|extension| format!("{extension}."))
   621	                        .unwrap_or_default()
   622	                ))
   623	            })
   624	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
   625	        for backup in &backup_paths {
   626	            if backup.exists() {
   627	                bail!(
   628	                    "refusing to overwrite prior rebuild backup {}",
   629	                    backup.display()
   630	                );
   631	            }
   632	        }
   633	        for (path, backup) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {
   634	            if path.exists() {
   635	                if let Err(preserve_error) = tokio::fs::rename(path, backup).await {
   636	                    for (original, preserved) in db_paths.iter().zip(&backup_paths) {
   637	                        if preserved.exists() {
   638	                            let _ = tokio::fs::rename(preserved, original).await;
   639	                        }
   640	                    }
   641	                    return Err(preserve_error).with_context(|| {
   642	                        format!(
   643	                            "failed to preserve {} as {}; prior files were restored",
   644	                            path.display(),
   645	                            backup.display()
   646	                        )
   647	                    });
   648	                }
   649	            }
   650	        }

codex
The repository already has a configurable `MendConfig.stuck_threshold_secs` (currently unused for claims), so I’ll use that existing setting as the claim-age TTL rather than adding a second knob. I’ll preserve the public orphan-cleanup API for Explore, while Mend will invoke an age-aware variant; old/fresh live claims remain protected, and stale claims are released even when the registry PID is alive.

/// Scan all in-progress beads in a store and release any whose assignee is
/// orphaned or whose claim is older than `claim_ttl`. Claim age is independent
/// of worker liveness so a worker name that is reused by a relaunch cannot pin
/// a bead forever.
async fn cleanup_in_progress(
    store: &dyn BeadStore,
    registry: &Registry,
    telemetry: &Telemetry,
    qualified_id: &str,
    claim_ttl: Option<Duration>,
) -> Result<u32> {
    let all_beads = store.list_all().await?;

    // Registry::list() does blocking file I/O and PID checks.
    // Use spawn_blocking to avoid blocking the async executor.
    let registry_for_blocking = registry.clone();
    let workers = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || registry_for_blocking.list())
        .await
        .context("spawn_blocking task for registry.list() failed")?
        .context("registry.list() failed")?;

    // Build a set of fully-qualified worker IDs for registered, alive workers.
    let live_worker_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = workers
        .iter()
        .filter(|w| HealthMonitor::check_pid_alive(w.pid))
        .map(|w| w.id.clone())
        .collect();

    let mut released = 0u32;

    let now = Utc::now();

    for bead in &all_beads {
        if bead.status != BeadStatus::InProgress {
            continue;
        }

        let assignee = match &bead.assignee {
            Some(a) if !a.is_empty() => a,
            _ => continue,
        };

        let claim_age = now.signed_duration_since(bead.updated_at).to_std().ok();
        let stale_by_age = claim_ttl.is_some_and(|ttl| {
            claim_age
                .map(|age| age >= ttl)
                .unwrap_or(false)
        });

        // Claim age is an independent release condition. A live worker may
        // still hold an abandoned claim, especially when --count 1 relaunches
        // under the same worker name indefinitely.
        if !stale_by_age && assignee == qualified_id {
            continue;
        }

        // Skip if the assignee matches a registered, alive worker unless the
        // claim has exceeded its age limit. Workers register with fully-qualified
        // IDs ({adapter}-{worker_id}), so this comparison prevents collisions
        // when workers from different adapter pools share a NATO name.
        if !stale_by_age && live_worker_ids.contains(assignee.as_str()) {
            continue;
        }

        let reason = if stale_by_age {
            let age_secs = claim_age.map_or(0, |age| age.as_secs());
            format!(
                "stale claim: age {age_secs}s exceeds configured claim TTL"
            )
        } else {
            format!("orphaned: assignee {assignee} has no live worker")
        };

        tracing::info!(
            bead_id = %bead.id,
            assignee = %assignee,
            age_secs = claim_age.map_or(0, |age| age.as_secs()),
            stale_by_age,
            workspace = %bead.workspace.display(),
            "releasing stale in-progress bead"
        );

        match store.release(&bead.id).await {
            Ok(()) => {
                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
                    reason,
                });
                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::StuckReleased {
                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
                    peer_worker: assignee.clone(),
                });
                released += 1;
            }
            Err(e) => {
                tracing::warn!(
                    bead_id = %bead.id,
                    error = %e,
                    "failed to release orphaned in-progress bead"
                );
                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendBeadReleaseFailed {
                    bead_id: bead.id.to_string(),
                    assignee: assignee.clone(),
                    error: e.to_string(),
                });
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(released)
}

            trace_retention_success_days,
            workspace,
            max_learnings,
            state_dir,
            limits_config,
        }
    }

     #[tokio::test]
+    async fn stale_in_progress_bead_released_even_when_worker_is_alive() {
+        let hb_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let lock_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let reg_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+
+        // The worker is alive, but the claim is far older than Mend's configured
+        // claim TTL. This is the failure mode that liveness-only cleanup misses.
+        let bead = make_in_progress_bead("nd-stale-live", "alive-worker");
+
+        let registry = Registry::new(reg_dir.path());
+        registry
+            .register(crate::registry::WorkerEntry {
+                id: "alive-worker".to_string(),
+                pid: std::process::id(),
+                workspace: PathBuf::from("/tmp/test"),
+                agent: "test".to_string(),
+                model: None,
+                provider: None,
+                started_at: Utc::now(),
+                beads_processed: 1,
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+
+        let (store, release_count, _) = MockBeadStore::new(vec![bead]);
+        let mend = MendStrand::new(
+            MendConfig {
+                stuck_threshold_secs: 60,
+                ..MendConfig::default()
+            },
+            hb_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            Duration::from_secs(300),
+            lock_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            "test-worker".to_string(),
+            registry,
+            Telemetry::new("test-worker".to_string()),
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/needle-test-logs"),
+            0,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/test-traces"),
+            30,
+            7,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace"),
+            80,
+            tempfile::tempdir().unwrap().path().to_path_buf(),
+            LimitsConfig::default(),
+        );
+
+        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;
+        assert!(
+            matches!(result, StrandResult::WorkCreated),
+            "expected WorkCreated after reclaiming stale live claim, got: {result:?}"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(release_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
+    }

     #[tokio::test]
+    async fn stale_in_progress_bead_released_even_when_worker_is_alive() {
+        let hb_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let lock_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let reg_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+
+        // The worker is alive, but the claim is far older than Mend's configured
+        // claim TTL. This is the failure mode that liveness-only cleanup misses.
+        let bead = make_in_progress_bead("nd-stale-live", "alive-worker");
+
+        let registry = Registry::new(reg_dir.path());
+        registry
+            .register(crate::registry::WorkerEntry {
+                id: "alive-worker".to_string(),
+                pid: std::process::id(),
+                workspace: PathBuf::from("/tmp/test"),
+                agent: "test".to_string(),
+                model: None,
+                provider: None,
+                started_at: Utc::now(),
+                beads_processed: 1,
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+
+        let (store, release_count, _) = MockBeadStore::new(vec![bead]);
+        let mend = MendStrand::new(
+            MendConfig {
+                stuck_threshold_secs: 60,
+                ..MendConfig::default()
+            },
+            hb_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            Duration::from_secs(300),
+            lock_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            "test-worker".to_string(),
+            registry,
+            Telemetry::new("test-worker".to_string()),
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/needle-test-logs"),
+            0,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/test-traces"),
+            30,
+            7,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace"),
+            80,
+            tempfile::tempdir().unwrap().path().to_path_buf(),
+            LimitsConfig::default(),
+        );
+
+        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;
+        assert!(
+            matches!(result, StrandResult::WorkCreated),
+            "expected WorkCreated after reclaiming stale live claim, got: {result:?}"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(release_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
+    }

Author:     jedarden <github@jedarden.com>

CommitDate: Mon Aug 17 00:59:53 2026 -0400

    fix(config): restore .needle.yaml parseability — verification must be a sequence
    
    `verification:` at the workspace level is the legacy alias for `gates:` and
    deserializes as Option<Vec<String>>. 0bf3111 wrote it as a mapping holding
    `outcome_timeout_seconds`, so the whole file failed to parse with:
    
        verification: invalid type: map, expected a sequence at line 158 column 3
    
    Already-running workers kept going on their in-memory config, so nothing looked
    wrong — but every new `needle run` against this workspace aborted at boot. That
    capped NEEDLE at the two workers that happened to predate the change and left
    the fleet unable to self-heal or scale for ~18h.
    
    `outcome_timeout_seconds` is not workspace-overridable; it belongs to the global
    ValidationConfig and is now set under `validation:` in ~/.needle/config.yaml.
    The `gates:` block already covers this workspace's verification, so nothing is
    lost by dropping the mapping.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

    48	/// * `Ok(u32)` - Number of orphans released
    49	/// * `Err(anyhow::Error)` - Store read failure
    50	pub async fn cleanup_orphaned_in_progress(
    51	    store: &dyn BeadStore,
    52	    registry: &Registry,
    53	    telemetry: &Telemetry,
    54	    qualified_id: &str,
    55	) -> Result<u32> {
    56	    let all_beads = store.list_all().await?;
    57	
    58	    // Registry::list() does blocking file I/O and PID checks.
    59	    // Use spawn_blocking to avoid blocking the async executor.
    60	    let registry_for_blocking = registry.clone();
    61	    let workers = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || registry_for_blocking.list())
    62	        .await
    63	        .context("spawn_blocking task for registry.list() failed")?
    64	        .context("registry.list() failed")?;
    65	
    66	    // Build a set of fully-qualified worker IDs for registered, alive workers.
    67	    let live_worker_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = workers
    68	        .iter()
    69	        .filter(|w| HealthMonitor::check_pid_alive(w.pid))
    70	        .map(|w| w.id.clone())
    71	        .collect();
    72	
    73	    let mut released = 0u32;
    74	
    75	    for bead in &all_beads {
    76	        if bead.status != BeadStatus::InProgress {
    77	            continue;
    78	        }
    79	
    80	        let assignee = match &bead.assignee {
    81	            Some(a) if !a.is_empty() => a,
    82	            _ => continue,
    83	        };
    84	
    85	        // Skip if the assignee matches our own qualified identity (we're running).
    86	        if assignee == qualified_id {
    87	            continue;
    88	        }
    89	
    90	        // Skip if the assignee matches a registered, alive worker.
    91	        // Workers register with fully-qualified IDs ({adapter}-{worker_id}),
    92	        // so this comparison prevents collisions when workers from different
    93	        // adapter pools share a NATO name.
    94	        if live_worker_ids.contains(assignee.as_str()) {
    95	            continue;
    96	        }
    97	
    98	        // Orphaned: assignee is not a live registered worker. Release it.
    99	        tracing::info!(
   100	            bead_id = %bead.id,
   101	            assignee = %assignee,
   102	            workspace = %bead.workspace.display(),
   103	            "releasing orphaned in-progress bead (assignee has no live worker)"
   104	        );
   105	
   106	        match store.release(&bead.id).await {
   107	            Ok(()) => {
   108	                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
   109	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   110	                    reason: format!("orphaned: assignee {} has no live worker", assignee),
   111	                });
   112	                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::StuckReleased {
   113	                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
   114	                    peer_worker: assignee.clone(),
   115	                });
   116	                released += 1;
   117	            }
   118	            Err(e) => {
   119	                tracing::warn!(
   120	                    bead_id = %bead.id,
   121	                    error = %e,
   122	                    "failed to release orphaned in-progress bead"
   123	                );

   125	                    bead_id: bead.id.to_string(),
   126	                    assignee: assignee.clone(),
   127	                    error: e.to_string(),
   128	                });
   129	            }
   130	        }
   131	    }

     #[tokio::test]
+    async fn stale_in_progress_bead_released_even_when_worker_is_alive() {
+        let hb_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let lock_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let reg_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+
+        // The worker is alive, but the claim is far older than Mend's configured
+        // claim TTL. This is the failure mode that liveness-only cleanup misses.
+        let bead = make_in_progress_bead("nd-stale-live", "alive-worker");
+
+        let registry = Registry::new(reg_dir.path());
+        registry
+            .register(crate::registry::WorkerEntry {
+                id: "alive-worker".to_string(),
+                pid: std::process::id(),
+                workspace: PathBuf::from("/tmp/test"),
+                agent: "test".to_string(),
+                model: None,
+                provider: None,
+                started_at: Utc::now(),
+                beads_processed: 1,
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+
+        let (store, release_count, _) = MockBeadStore::new(vec![bead]);
+        let mend = MendStrand::new(
+            MendConfig {
+                stuck_threshold_secs: 60,
+                ..MendConfig::default()
+            },
+            hb_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            Duration::from_secs(300),
+            lock_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            "test-worker".to_string(),
+            registry,
+            Telemetry::new("test-worker".to_string()),
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/needle-test-logs"),
+            0,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/test-traces"),
+            30,
+            7,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace"),
+            80,
+            tempfile::tempdir().unwrap().path().to_path_buf(),
+            LimitsConfig::default(),
+        );
+
+        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;
+        assert!(
+            matches!(result, StrandResult::WorkCreated),
+            "expected WorkCreated after reclaiming stale live claim, got: {result:?}"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(release_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
+    }

/// * `qualified_id` - This worker's fully-qualified identity (excluded from orphan detection)
///
/// # Returns
/// * `Ok(u32)` - Number of orphans released
/// * `Err(anyhow::Error)` - Store read failure
pub async fn cleanup_orphaned_in_progress(
    store: &dyn BeadStore,
    registry: &Registry,
    telemetry: &Telemetry,
    qualified_id: &str,
) -> Result<u32> {
    let all_beads = store.list_all().await?;

    // Registry::list() does blocking file I/O and PID checks.
    // Use spawn_blocking to avoid blocking the async executor.
    let registry_for_blocking = registry.clone();
    let workers = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || registry_for_blocking.list())
        .await
        .context("spawn_blocking task for registry.list() failed")?
        .context("registry.list() failed")?;

    // Build a set of fully-qualified worker IDs for registered, alive workers.
    let live_worker_ids: std::collections::HashSet<String> = workers
        .iter()
        .filter(|w| HealthMonitor::check_pid_alive(w.pid))
        .map(|w| w.id.clone())
        .collect();

    let mut released = 0u32;

    for bead in &all_beads {
        if bead.status != BeadStatus::InProgress {
            continue;
        }

        let assignee = match &bead.assignee {
            Some(a) if !a.is_empty() => a,
            _ => continue,
        };

        // Skip if the assignee matches our own qualified identity (we're running).
        if assignee == qualified_id {
            continue;
        }

        // Skip if the assignee matches a registered, alive worker.
        // Workers register with fully-qualified IDs ({adapter}-{worker_id}),
        // so this comparison prevents collisions when workers from different
        // adapter pools share a NATO name.
        if live_worker_ids.contains(assignee.as_str()) {
            continue;
        }

        // Orphaned: assignee is not a live registered worker. Release it.
        tracing::info!(
            bead_id = %bead.id,
            assignee = %assignee,
            workspace = %bead.workspace.display(),
            "releasing orphaned in-progress bead (assignee has no live worker)"
        );

        match store.release(&bead.id).await {
            Ok(()) => {
                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::BeadReleased {
                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
                    reason: format!("orphaned: assignee {} has no live worker", assignee),
                });
                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::StuckReleased {
                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),
                    peer_worker: assignee.clone(),
                });
                released += 1;
            }
            Err(e) => {
                tracing::warn!(
                    bead_id = %bead.id,
                    error = %e,
                    "failed to release orphaned in-progress bead"
                );
                let _ = telemetry.emit(EventKind::MendBeadReleaseFailed {
                    bead_id: bead.id.to_string(),
                    assignee: assignee.clone(),
                    error: e.to_string(),
                });
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(released)
}

/// Summary of work performed during one Mend evaluation cycle.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct MendSummary {
    beads_released: u32,
    locks_removed: u32,
    deps_cleaned: u32,
    db_repaired: bool,
    db_rebuilt: bool,
    agent_logs_cleaned: u32,
    zero_activity_logs_cleaned: u32,
    traces_pruned: u32,
    traces_cleaned: u32,
    learnings_pruned: u32,
    learnings_consolidated: u32,
    orphaned_heartbeats_removed: u32,
    workers_deregistered: u32,
    idle_workers_flagged: u32,
    rate_limits_cleaned: u32,
    rate_limit_providers_removed: u32,
    rate_limit_providers_reset: u32,
    assignees_cleared: u32,
}

impl MendSummary {
    /// Whether mend performed work that changes bead store state.
    ///
    /// Only operations that add or release claimable beads should return true.
    /// A strand MUST return `WorkCreated` only when it inserts a claimable bead
    /// into the store that the waterfall will re-scan. No-op cleanup (pruning
    /// traces, removing stale locks, repairing DB) should return `NoWork`.
    ///
    /// Operations that return `WorkCreated`:
    /// - `beads_released > 0`: Orphaned beads were released back to Open status.
    /// - `deps_cleaned > 0`: Stale dependency links were removed (beads become claimable).
    /// - `assignees_cleared > 0`: Stale assignees were cleared (beads become claimable).
    ///
    /// Operations that return `NoWork` (maintenance, not work creation):
    /// - `locks_removed > 0`: Lock file cleanup (doesn't add beads to queue).
    /// - `db_repaired`: Doctor repair fixed index corruption (doesn't add beads).
    /// - `db_rebuilt`: Full rebuild from JSONL (doesn't add beads).
    /// - `traces_pruned`, `agent_logs_cleaned`, `learnings_*`: File cleanup.
    ///
    /// A `WorkCreated` return must be paired with a telemetry event identifying
    /// the created bead(s) so operators can see what the restart is chasing.
    fn did_work(&self) -> bool {

     #[tokio::test]
+    async fn stale_in_progress_bead_released_even_when_worker_is_alive() {
+        let hb_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let lock_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let reg_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+
+        // The worker is alive, but the claim is far older than Mend's configured
+        // claim TTL. This is the failure mode that liveness-only cleanup misses.
+        let bead = make_in_progress_bead("nd-stale-live", "alive-worker");
+
+        let registry = Registry::new(reg_dir.path());
+        registry
+            .register(crate::registry::WorkerEntry {
+                id: "alive-worker".to_string(),
+                pid: std::process::id(),
+                workspace: PathBuf::from("/tmp/test"),
+                agent: "test".to_string(),
+                model: None,
+                provider: None,
+                started_at: Utc::now(),
+                beads_processed: 1,
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+
+        let (store, release_count, _) = MockBeadStore::new(vec![bead]);
+        let mend = MendStrand::new(
+            MendConfig {
+                stuck_threshold_secs: 60,
+                ..MendConfig::default()
+            },
+            hb_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            Duration::from_secs(300),
+            lock_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            "test-worker".to_string(),
+            registry,
+            Telemetry::new("test-worker".to_string()),
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/needle-test-logs"),
+            0,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/test-traces"),
+            30,
+            7,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace"),
+            80,
+            tempfile::tempdir().unwrap().path().to_path_buf(),
+            LimitsConfig::default(),
+        );
+
+        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;
+        assert!(
+            matches!(result, StrandResult::WorkCreated),
+            "expected WorkCreated after reclaiming stale live claim, got: {result:?}"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(release_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
+    }

+/// a bead forever.

+        // under the same worker name indefinitely.

+        if !stale_by_age && live_worker_ids.contains(assignee.as_str()) {

-        // Orphaned: assignee is not a live registered worker. Release it.

+        };

         tracing::info!(

     #[tokio::test]
+    async fn stale_in_progress_bead_released_even_when_worker_is_alive() {
+        let hb_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let lock_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let reg_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+
+        // The worker is alive, but the claim is far older than Mend's configured
+        // claim TTL. This is the failure mode that liveness-only cleanup misses.
+        let bead = make_in_progress_bead("nd-stale-live", "alive-worker");
+
+        let registry = Registry::new(reg_dir.path());
+        registry
+            .register(crate::registry::WorkerEntry {
+                id: "alive-worker".to_string(),
+                pid: std::process::id(),
+                workspace: PathBuf::from("/tmp/test"),
+                agent: "test".to_string(),
+                model: None,
+                provider: None,
+                started_at: Utc::now(),
+                beads_processed: 1,
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+
+        let (store, release_count, _) = MockBeadStore::new(vec![bead]);
+        let mend = MendStrand::new(
+            MendConfig {
+                stuck_threshold_secs: 60,
+                ..MendConfig::default()
+            },
+            hb_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            Duration::from_secs(300),
+            lock_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            "test-worker".to_string(),
+            registry,
+            Telemetry::new("test-worker".to_string()),
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/needle-test-logs"),
+            0,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/test-traces"),
+            30,
+            7,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace"),
+            80,
+            tempfile::tempdir().unwrap().path().to_path_buf(),
+            LimitsConfig::default(),
+        );
+
+        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;
+        assert!(
+            matches!(result, StrandResult::WorkCreated),
+            "expected WorkCreated after reclaiming stale live claim, got: {result:?}"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(release_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
+    }

     #[tokio::test]
+    async fn stale_in_progress_bead_released_even_when_worker_is_alive() {
+        let hb_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let lock_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let reg_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+
+        // The worker is alive, but the claim is far older than Mend's configured
+        // claim TTL. This is the failure mode that liveness-only cleanup misses.
+        let bead = make_in_progress_bead("nd-stale-live", "alive-worker");
+
+        let registry = Registry::new(reg_dir.path());
+        registry
+            .register(crate::registry::WorkerEntry {
+                id: "alive-worker".to_string(),
+                pid: std::process::id(),
+                workspace: PathBuf::from("/tmp/test"),
+                agent: "test".to_string(),
+                model: None,
+                provider: None,
+                started_at: Utc::now(),
+                beads_processed: 1,
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+
+        let (store, release_count, _) = MockBeadStore::new(vec![bead]);
+        let mend = MendStrand::new(
+            MendConfig {
+                stuck_threshold_secs: 60,
+                ..MendConfig::default()
+            },
+            hb_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            Duration::from_secs(300),
+            lock_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            "test-worker".to_string(),
+            registry,
+            Telemetry::new("test-worker".to_string()),
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/needle-test-logs"),
+            0,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/test-traces"),
+            30,
+            7,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace"),
+            80,
+            tempfile::tempdir().unwrap().path().to_path_buf(),
+            LimitsConfig::default(),
+        );
+
+        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;
+        assert!(
+            matches!(result, StrandResult::WorkCreated),
+            "expected WorkCreated after reclaiming stale live claim, got: {result:?}"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(release_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
+    }

+                beads_processed: 1,

+

+        let mend = MendStrand::new(
+            MendConfig {
+                stuck_threshold_secs: 60,
+                ..MendConfig::default()
+            },
+            hb_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            Duration::from_secs(300),

+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/test-traces"),

+            7,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace"),
+            80,
+            tempfile::tempdir().unwrap().path().to_path_buf(),
+            LimitsConfig::default(),
+        );
+
+        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;

+        );

+

+        // under the same worker name indefinitely.
+        if !stale_by_age && assignee == qualified_id {

+        if !stale_by_age && live_worker_ids.contains(assignee.as_str()) {

+
         tracing::info!(

     #[tokio::test]
+    async fn stale_in_progress_bead_released_even_when_worker_is_alive() {
+        let hb_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let lock_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+        let reg_dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+
+        // The worker is alive, but the claim is far older than Mend's configured
+        // claim TTL. This is the failure mode that liveness-only cleanup misses.
+        let bead = make_in_progress_bead("nd-stale-live", "alive-worker");
+
+        let registry = Registry::new(reg_dir.path());
+        registry
+            .register(crate::registry::WorkerEntry {
+                id: "alive-worker".to_string(),
+                pid: std::process::id(),
+                workspace: PathBuf::from("/tmp/test"),
+                agent: "test".to_string(),
+                model: None,
+                provider: None,
+                started_at: Utc::now(),
+                beads_processed: 1,
+            })
+            .unwrap();
+
+        let (store, release_count, _) = MockBeadStore::new(vec![bead]);
+        let mend = MendStrand::new(
+            MendConfig {
+                stuck_threshold_secs: 60,
+                ..MendConfig::default()
+            },
+            hb_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            Duration::from_secs(300),
+            lock_dir.path().to_path_buf(),
+            "test-worker".to_string(),
+            registry,
+            Telemetry::new("test-worker".to_string()),
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/needle-test-logs"),
+            0,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/test-traces"),
+            30,
+            7,
+            PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace"),
+            80,
+            tempfile::tempdir().unwrap().path().to_path_buf(),
+            LimitsConfig::default(),
+        );
+
+        let result = mend.evaluate(&store, &HashSet::new()).await;
+        assert!(
+            matches!(result, StrandResult::WorkCreated),
+            "expected WorkCreated after reclaiming stale live claim, got: {result:?}"
+        );
+        assert_eq!(release_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
+    }
+

/bin/bash -lc 'bead show needle-f6afd68c 2>/dev/null | head -40' in /home/coding/NEEDLE
 succeeded in 0ms:
ID: needle-f6afd68c
Title: mend cannot reclaim a stale claim whose worker name is still alive (no claim-age check)
Status: Closed
Priority: P1
Revision: 5
Created: 2026-08-17T02:51:20.772319806Z
Updated: 2026-08-17T05:06:42.549885691Z
Description: src/strand/mend.rs:66-96 releases an in_progress bead ONLY when its assignee has
no live PID:

    if live_worker_ids.contains(assignee.as_str()) {
        continue;
    }

There is no claim-age check anywhere in that loop. The only TTL in the module is
heartbeat_ttl, which gates heartbeat FILES, not bead claims. The bead updated_at is
never consulted. So the release condition is purely "is the worker process dead."

Because --count 1 workers relaunch under the same name indefinitely, an abandoned
claim held by a still-running name is skipped on every mend pass forever, no matter
how old. Observed in tradegraph 2026-08-17: claims aged 11-27h, skipped repeatedly
while the fleet ran, ready frontier pinned at 0.

This is the safety net failing. The claim leak upstream is needle-55ec0193; fixing
that reduces the inflow but does not make the net sound -- any future abandonment
path reproduces the starvation.

FIX (interim, no schema change): add a second, independent release condition on
claim age using updated_at, which is already in the store. Fires regardless of
holder liveness. Approximate -- any update refreshes updated_at -- but it would have
caught all 9 tradegraph cases.

FIX (durable): model a claim as a lease rather than an unbounded assignment --
(bead_id, holder, claimed_at, renewed_at, lease_ttl), renewed by the worker while it
is actively working THAT bead. Mend releases any expired lease regardless of holder
liveness. Notes on shape:
  - Key per CLAIM, not per worker. A per-worker "most recently claimed bead" record
    is insufficient and actively misleading: tradegraph-1s most recent claim was
    3.6h old and looked healthy while six older claims rotted behind it.
  - Prefer claimed_at/lease_expires_at columns on the issue row over a side table --
